caption: The video showcases an elaborate domino rally spread across a wooden floor, with a yellow hub and colored spokes at left, a green squiggle and red bridge at top, and a blue slide, block pyramid and yellow loop feeding a blue ramp at right. A wavy black chain snakes from the middle down to a thick black block that joins a straight yellow line near the ramp's base. During the clip the terminal loop of the black chain topples, setting the thick block to fall end over end while the long wavy section stays upright. That collapse then reaches the yellow line, whose toppling front travels from the left end toward the right. The camera drifts right and down, moving the hub and top slide out of view while bringing the white-domino row, a yellow device and a red-and-white ladder into frame. The green squiggle, spokes, yellow loop, ramp dominoes, white row and pyramid all remain standing. The cascade is still progressing as the clip ends.
